propositions: Duplicate tickets with identical titles are only detected after mid-implementation, not at creation time, because create_core performs no overlap/similarity check by design.

Same-title duplicates in the store cluster within 171 seconds of their twin (temporal burst signature), and normalized-title + <5 minute window matching yields 100% precision (7/7 true duplicates) with minimal false positives.

A bounded O(window) sidecar journal (recent-creates.json, 600s recency window) probed under fcntl.flock before each create can surface same-title candidates at creation time without O(store) scan cost or write-path regression.

The duplicate warning must be advisory-only (never blocks creation, exit code 0) and surfaced on all channels (CLI stderr, library dict, MCP result field) to match GitHub/GitLab/Kubernetes/VS Code precedent.
A sanctioned post-close path (reopen -> link duplicates -> re-close --class duplicate) exists for recording duplicate relations on closed tickets, avoiding the need to mutate closed tickets directly.
